policy.note: Thresholds marked provisional:true are starting values chosen before any evaluation (20 Nov 2026), when only 2 sessions had complete intraday inputs. They require the evidence named in 'needs' before they can be derived from history instead.

promotion.direction_floor: no direction with 5+ shadow trades may have expectancy below the champion's in that direction by more than the champion's average loss
promotion.needs: a forward shadow history of 15+ sessions and 20+ settled trades

experiments.selection_bias: Each test window is used by one cycle only (burned); the required confidence rises with the number of candidates compared in the cycle: lower bound at level 1 - 0.20 / k.
experiments.needs: 15+ sessions with complete inputs before any candidate can be evaluated
